rad3q.0075649EE009DB72.desc.0: The trail leads you to a place the map shows as empty — a hollow in the forest floor ringed by dead oaks, their roots knotted together overhead into something that resembles a ribcage.
rad3q.0075649EE009DB72.desc.10: §o§8Maren, watching from somewhere in the tree line, says nothing. She will not help you. She's curious, you realise. She wants to see what happens when someone does this the hard way.§r§r
rad3q.0075649EE009DB72.desc.4: §o§8It has no body, not exactly. It moves between the trees, a rippling wrongness in the air — like heat haze, but cold. You can feel the curse responding to it, pulling at you like a tide. The spirit recognises its own mark.§r§r
rad3q.0075649EE009DB72.desc.6: You have no ritual. No protection. No binding components.
rad3q.0075649EE009DB72.desc.8: §4You have a weapon and a reason. That will have to be enough.

rad3q.00ED99B6105C9DE1.desc.4: §o§3"Any soul with knowledge of the final resting place of §n§4Desram the Unbroken§r§r§3§o, once §6King of the Shattered Coves§r, §3is sought by the order of the Quill and Anchor.§r
rad3q.00ED99B6105C9DE1.desc.7: §o§8You've heard the name before. Every sailor has. Desram was a pirate king who vanished without dying — no shipwreck, no battle, no grave. Just gone. His sword, they say, went with him. And his sword, they say, chooses its bearer.§r§r
rad3q.00ED99B6105C9DE1.desc.9: The notice gives no address. Only a name: §6The Wandering Hold.§r

rad3q.011832728CF1D69F.desc.2: §2Twisted hawthorn branches§r form an arch overhead, and beneath them stands a ring of mossy stones, each carved with a different symbol. At the center, a cold fire pit still smells faintly of §5burned herbs§r.
rad3q.011832728CF1D69F.desc.4: §o§8Someone was here recently. The ash is still warm. Whoever set this pact came here, performed a ritual, and left in a hurry. The symbols on the stones are in a language you don't recognise — but one word repeats on each stone: a name. Your name.§r§r

rad3q.012FB4CD1F4DFF66.desc.0: The Paladin is a Fighter with the power of Light and healing magic, as well as defensive buffs for their allies. Most paladins got their powers from their devotion to gods but paladins do not nesessary follow or worship deities to gain power. Some paladins got their powers throught sacred oaths and virtues. Their dedication to their faith gives them various prayers, healing abilities and holy-based spells to protect themselves and others. Naturally, they are a type of Magic Knight. They are also quite good at laying the smite down on undead, demons and other traditionally evil supernatural creatures.

rad3q.0859A97708084F0D.desc.0: You ask around. Sailors, merchants, a half-deaf cartographer. Slowly, a picture forms.
rad3q.0859A97708084F0D.desc.10: §6the sword was never to be kept. Only carried. When its bearer proved themselves, they would pass it on. The blade would find the next hand that deserved it.§r
rad3q.0859A97708084F0D.desc.12: He disappeared before he could pass it on himself.
rad3q.0859A97708084F0D.desc.14: §o§8The fragments of his story are scattered across the same dungeons he once cleared. Find them, and you may find him.§r§r
rad3q.0859A97708084F0D.desc.4: §o§8Born in a fishing village with no name, he took his first ship at seventeen, his first fleet at twenty-three. He never claimed a crown — he said crowns were for people who needed others to know they won. But the Shattered Coves obeyed him. Every captain, every smuggler, every dock master who moved contraband through the southern routes did so under his shadow.§r§r
rad3q.0859A97708084F0D.desc.6: What made him legendary was not the conquests. It was the §6Questing Blade.§r
rad3q.0859A97708084F0D.desc.8: §o§8He forged it himself, they say. Not with a blacksmith's craft, but with §4three trials§r §o§8— dungeons he ran alone to prove he was worth the steel. And when it was done, he made a rule: §r§r
rad3q.0859A97708084F0D.title: The King's Legend
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.0: - §4Mob strength§r progress with player. Player §nwould not§r encounter absurdly strong mobs at the beginning
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.10: There is a §4level§r associated with all enemies. §4Level§r is determined by the §3dimension§r, §2biome§r, position, §6nearby player difficulty§r, and §centity type§r. As the §4level§r becomes higher, mobs have higher health and deal higher damage, and higher chance to have strong traits.
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.12: There is a §4difficulty level§r assigned to chunk sections and players.
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.14: §nKilling mobs§r to §ngain§r chunk and player difficulty, and §ndie§r to §nlose§r player difficulty.
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.16: Use §9Hostility Detector§r to know about current difficulty, use §5Hostility Spawner§r to make a chunk section permanently not spawning mobs with level.
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.2: - §4Mob strength§r are dependent on a lot of factors, instead of just being randomly strong.
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.4: - Reasonable progression: §cIncrease§r difficulty only when you kill strong enemies. §2Decrease§r difficulty when you die.
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.6: - There is a mechanic to make a region safe. You don't need to worry about strong mobs around your base
rad3q.085E485E8091D543.desc.8: - 28 curio items to make you stronger and 2 enchantments to help fighting the mobs.

rad3q.0A2B64BF18182507.desc.0: §9The Ocean Monument§r looms from the dark water like a forgotten cathedral.
rad3q.0A2B64BF18182507.desc.2: Its stone corridors are patrolled by Guardians — ancient constructs that seem almost... deliberate. As if placed here to protect something specific.
rad3q.0A2B64BF18182507.desc.4: §o§8You push deeper, past the Elder Guardian's territory, into the monument's flooded heart. And there — wedged between two prismarine pillars — is a chest bearing the privateer's emblem. A compass rose, surrounded by a serpent biting its own tail.§r§r

rad3q.0A9AB758ADFBDEBA.desc.0: You search the settlement for clues about where everyone went.
rad3q.0A9AB758ADFBDEBA.desc.10: You are going to need supplies before you follow them down.
rad3q.0A9AB758ADFBDEBA.desc.2: The homes are tidy but personal — a child's toy left on a windowsill, a half-knitted sock on a chair, a pot still hanging over a cold hearth. These weren't soldiers following an evacuation order. These were families.
rad3q.0A9AB758ADFBDEBA.desc.4: §o§8In the settlement's small library you find a journal. Most of it is mundane: supply orders, shift rotations, complaints about the water pressure in the lower forges. But the final entry is different in tone:§r§r
rad3q.0A9AB758ADFBDEBA.desc.6: §6§o"The Vein sang again last night. Thrumvor says it's getting louder. He won't tell us what it's saying. He says we wouldn't want to know. We leave at first bell. The Deep Works await. Ancestors guide our hands."§r§r
rad3q.0A9AB758ADFBDEBA.desc.8: §o§8The Vein. Every mention of the dwarves' collapse references it — something they found deep underground that sang. Something that required a seal.§r§r

rad3q.0C2E1DD15D80D4F7.desc.0: Parrying is a relatively simple mechanic. When you are hit with a melee attack, if you are swinging a weapon the attack will be deflected. rad3q.0DA780E82198E59C.desc.0: - Piglins now have a reputation system that works similarly to Villagers. Doing things like fighting alongside them against Wither mobs, giving them gifts and bartering with them increases your reputation. Doing things like hurting or killing Piglin mobs and engaging in unauthorized mining/chest opening around them decreases your reputation.
rad3q.0DA780E82198E59C.desc.10: - Piglins now shake their heads like Villagers when declining an offered item.
rad3q.0DA780E82198E59C.desc.12: Piglins now emit particles/make sounds when accepting an item from you or declining it.
rad3q.0DA780E82198E59C.desc.2: - At +50 reputation with a Piglin, you will no longer be required to wear gold armor around them. At +100 reputation, you will be authorized to open chests and mine gold around them.
rad3q.0DA780E82198E59C.desc.4: - At -50 reputation with a Piglin, you will no longer receive items from bartering. At -100 reputation, you will be attacked on sight regardless of whether or not you are wearing gold armor.
rad3q.0DA780E82198E59C.desc.6: - Piglins seek out and pick up food items (by default, porkchops and cooked porkchops) and consume them, complete with an eating animation. Players can also right-click them with their food items if the Piglin has not already recently eaten and they will accept it. Eating food will also restore a Piglin's health in an amount identical to the food item's hunger value.
rad3q.0DA780E82198E59C.desc.8: - Piglins can now barter with gold nuggets and gold blocks. Gold nuggets make you far more likely to receive common barter items, with all item stack sizes halved. Gold blocks make you far more likely to receive rare barter items, with all item stack sizes doubled.
rad3q.0DAB16C5E892D9A0.desc.0: Very handy for preventing Endermen or other teleporting mobs from teleporting away from you.

rad3q.14F6CBFA581F6A50.desc.0: Dodge is a movement ability, similar to sprinting. By holding alt (configurable) and tapping A, S, or D (or whatever keys your movement is bound to) you can leap left, backwards, or right, respectively. This ability has a short, invisible cooldown. Knockback resistance has an adverse effect on dodging, reducing its power. Thus, wearing Netherite armor will make dodging somewhat less effective. Additionally, you must be touching the ground to dodge, so it may not always be effective in pvp due to the large amount of jumping. rad3q.18F8DADD01FEC9C2.desc.4: Meals tend to be quite large, so they don't stack up as high in your inventory. rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.0: The §lDungeon Raid System§r is a custom roguelite layer built on top of the dungeon. Every run you enter, your performance is tracked — §lkills§r, §lchests opened§r, §lbosses slain§r, and §ltime survived§r all count toward your rewards.
rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.10: §lCursed Chests§r — some chests are cursed. Opening them still gives loot, but also applies a debuff for a couple of minutes. Risk it.
rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.13: §7/raidstats §r— view your rank, XP, and lifetime statistics
rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.15: §7/raidvault withdraw <amount> §r— move tokens to your inventory
rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.16: §7/raidvault deposit §r— deposit held tokens back into the vault
rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.2: At the end of each run you earn §6Raid Tokens§r, deposited automatically into your §6Raid Vault§r. Spend them here in this chapter to buy keys, items, and passes.
rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.4: §lRank §r— the more you raid, the higher your rank. Higher rank means stronger mobs, but also a better token multiplier and access to greater rewards.
rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.6: §lDeath§r — dying in the dungeon costs a portion of your current rank progress. You can never lose a rank from dying, but it slows you down.
rad3q.1B03F4233450669A.desc.8: §lRoom Events§r — once per run, a random modifier fires mid-run. It might buff you, curse the mobs, or make things considerably harder. Adapt.

rad3q.21ED1D6F4A0DADA6.desc.0: Fighter puts emphasis on strength and physical combat. Wielding melee weapons, they typically lack range, or have only limited ranged attack options, but they excel at fighting enemies in close range combat, often having high HP, defense, and attack capabilities to aid in this. In a team or party based game they put themselves at risk at the front of the group and take the brunt of the damage meant for their less sturdy comrades. A Fighter's strength is boosted by the wide variety of equipment they can use and they are usually able to equip the widest variety of weaponry and armor, including stuff too heavy for other classes. Most of the time the Fighter is considered the default "hero" class and as such they are often considered good for beginners.
rad3q.2205A97ACB6A9309.desc.0: A blank key cannot be used to enter a dungeon. A newly crafted key must first be used in an 'activation ritual' which will inscribe the name and location of a randomly generated dungeon onto the key. This action will require you to bring the key to a fitting location on The Overworld.
rad3q.2205A97ACB6A9309.desc.2: Basically, find a Stronghold, and use the key on the top of an End Portal Frame. You must aim for the black square on top.
rad3q.2205A97ACB6A9309.desc.4: Go back to your portal frame and place the key in the keyhole. If everything is correct then a golden dungeon portal should appear. If the frame was not built correctly then the portal will shatter immediately.
rad3q.2205A97ACB6A9309.desc.6: Keys can only be written to once. However keys are absolutely reusable! If you find a dungeon that is worth visiting more than once be sure to save that key somewhere in your base. A named key will always consistently take you back to the same dungeon.
rad3q.2205A97ACB6A9309.title: Activating Portal Keys

rad3q.2226FC4894277EEB.desc.0: During the enchanting process, you spend §aexperience§r and §9Lapis Lazuli§r to enchant an item. From this, enchantments are randomly selected using some complex formulas. This quest explains that process.
rad3q.2226FC4894277EEB.desc.2: First, we'll go over how enchantments are selected. Each enchantment has a  §dPower Function§r, which controls what §dFinal  power§r will make a specific level available. Once all the available enchantments are gathered, some are selected randomly based on their weights.
rad3q.2226FC4894277EEB.desc.4: §dFinal Power§r is calculated using the following steps: Intially, you have a §6Base Power§r, which is the level you spent while enchanting. Then, §cQuanta§r and §eRectification§r modify your §6Base Power§r to produce your §dFinal power§r.
rad3q.2226FC4894277EEB.desc.6: The specifics of how each stat modifies your §6Base Power§r can be found in the §cQuanta§r and §eRectification§r entries. Typically, a higher §dFinal Power§r will get you access to higher level enchantments.

rad3q.2256D8378C8CA364.desc.0: You arrive at the designated meeting point.
rad3q.2256D8378C8CA364.desc.10: The battle rages on, a brutal dance of death. You're surrounded, but you fight with the ferocity of a cornered beast. Your blade sings a deadly song, each strike a testament to your survival instinct.
rad3q.2256D8378C8CA364.desc.12: You're not sure how much longer you can hold out, but you're determined to fight until your last breath.
rad3q.2256D8378C8CA364.desc.2: But something feels off. The air feels thick, charged with an undercurrent of tension.
rad3q.2256D8378C8CA364.desc.4: Bandits, their faces twisted in fury, charge from all around. They've been waiting for you, their ambush carefully planned.
rad3q.2256D8378C8CA364.desc.6: You've been lured into a trap, a carefully orchestrated ambush by the very man you thought was your ally.
rad3q.2256D8378C8CA364.desc.8: You're outnumbered, but you're not outmatched. You've honed your skills in countless battles, and they serve you well. You weave through the chaos, your senses heightened, your reflexes lightning-fast. You dispatch bandit after bandit, each fallen foe adding to your growing sense of triumph. But the fight is far from over. More bandits emerge from the shadows, their numbers seemingly endless.

rad3q.24E14180599B65BF.desc.0: A small clan of goblin traders has made camp in an alcove, surrounded by dwarven objects they clearly have no idea how to use.
rad3q.24E14180599B65BF.desc.10: §2§o"That one? That one is §nspecial§r§2§o. Very expensive."§r§r
rad3q.24E14180599B65BF.desc.2: One of them — older, missing an ear, wearing what appears to be a dwarven forge-master's chain as a belt — notices you and immediately begins bargaining.
rad3q.24E14180599B65BF.desc.4: §2§o"Shiny things! Many shiny things! We found them here, all left behind, nobody wants them! You want? You trade?"§r§r
rad3q.24E14180599B65BF.desc.6: §o§8Among the clutter of dwarven tools and ornaments, something catches your eye: a §6small iron medallion§r, stamped with the same symbol above the settlement entrance. The Forge-Masters' seal. It shouldn't be here — it should be with the Forge-Masters. Wherever they went.§r§r
rad3q.24E14180599B65BF.desc.8: The goblin follows your gaze and clutches it defensively.

rad3q.25D2E4EECF49EA64.desc.10: §bThe Jackpot Slot (Tier 50+):§r You unlock a 5%% chance to trigger a §5legendary§r loot roll.
rad3q.25D2E4EECF49EA64.desc.15: In simple terms, §9Themes§r are the categories that define what kind of loot you get from your §6Sealed Tome§r.
rad3q.25D2E4EECF49EA64.desc.17: Instead of just getting "Zombie Loot" or "Skeleton Loot," the §5Echo Extractor§r analyzes the vibe of the block or spawner you are harvesting and classifies it into one of 31 distinct §9Themes§r (random process).
rad3q.25D2E4EECF49EA64.desc.19: §9Themes§r that you have discovered are listed in §eChronicle Of Echoes§r. At the moment, they are purely cosmetic and serve more to create an immersive effect.
rad3q.25D2E4EECF49EA64.desc.2: §bExpertise Tiers:§r Your rewards scale every §e10 Expertise Levels§r. Every tier lowers the requirement for Rare loot.
rad3q.25D2E4EECF49EA64.desc.4: §bTier 1+:§r Uncommon loot unlocked. You become eligible for the gold bonus (30%% chance). Further amount is scaled by your §eExpertise Level§r.
rad3q.25D2E4EECF49EA64.desc.8: §bThe "Grandmaster" Perk (Tier 50):§r If you ever reach Tier 50 (§eExpertise Level§r 500), the gold nuggets you receive as a bonus will transform into Gold Ingots.

rad3q.2620A08E1295B3A3.desc.10: Nullscape boosts the End's height to 384 blocks, introduces a new terrain system based around materials science. Essentially, different regions of the End - on very large scales - have different properties and a different 'feel' to allow for almost infinite variation in terrain shapes. From sponge-like porous terrain to stretched alien landscapes to stacked rounded islands, you'll find new and interesting terrain no matter how far you go.
rad3q.2620A08E1295B3A3.desc.2: Obsidian pillars, End gateways, the spawn platform, and the portal itself in the middle of the island have all been redesigned. Additionally, the dragon no longer spawns from the start - instead, it will be summoned once a player gets close to the bell tower in the center.
rad3q.2620A08E1295B3A3.desc.4: §lTo resummon the dragon§r, the 4 crystals no longer go right next to the portal. Instead, you'll see 4 bedrock blocks on the floor inside the tower, one in each directional wing of the building. The crystals can be placed on these 4 blocks to start summoning the dragon again. That being said, we do actually still support vanilla crystal summoning positions, to avoid confusing players who aren't familiar with the mod.
rad3q.2620A08E1295B3A3.desc.8: Overhauls the End's generation in a way that maintains this identity - §0§oa realm of utter desolation§r§r. Nullscape will make you feel tiny and alone in the vast expanse of the End. You against the void - nothing more than that.
rad3q.2620A08E1295B3A3.subtitle: Mods: YUNG's Better End Island, Nullscape

rad3q.27E4CBB51DBD27CD.desc.0: §4Ropes§r are essentially reverse scaffolding: the can be continuously deployed downward from the same spot, and can be climbed without collision. This allows players to safely descend or ascend high altitudes, such as ravines or mountains.
rad3q.27E4CBB51DBD27CD.desc.2: When placing Rope, you can use more ropes against the first one to deploy them downward. This will continuously extend a column of rope down to the bottom-most Y-level possible, allowing for easy and controllable descents into chasms, ravines or from high locations.
rad3q.27E4CBB51DBD27CD.desc.4: To suppress rope deployment, simply sneak while placing it. If there's no space underneath to deploy, it will also place normally.

rad3q.27FEA0B5D495FC9B.desc.0: Makes you immune to Blindness and Darkness for a few seconds. If you don't have anything better, it might be worth it to bring a few of these to the Deep Dark.

rad3q.28EA6E8682DF55FF.desc.0: Rich Soil is an enhanced type of dirt, more fertile and durable to the elements.
rad3q.28EA6E8682DF55FF.desc.2: Rich Soil cannot be directly crafted. To make it, you must craft Organic Compost and place it into the world, letting it decompose over time.
rad3q.28EA6E8682DF55FF.desc.4: Organic Compost will decompose more easily under sunlight and moisture from nearby water, but doesn't actually hydrate like farmland. It can also be gently accelerated by placing activators next to it, in a 3x3x3 area centered on itself.
rad3q.28EA6E8682DF55FF.desc.6: Currently, the following blocks behave as activators for Organic Compost:

rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.desc.0: You crack the second crate open in the half-dark of the maze's deepest chamber.
rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.desc.10: §6§o"When it finds the right hand, it will know. When that hand proves itself, they'll know too. Then they pass it on, and the cycle holds.§r§r
rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.desc.12: §6§o"Lose it? Come back for another. The trials don't close. That's the whole point."§r§r
rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.desc.14: §o§8The second fragment slots against the first in your pack. You can feel the third out there — somewhere cold and wet.§r§r
rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.desc.2: §o§8Same ritual. Glass vial. Parchment. More of that impossible sea smell.§r§r
rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.desc.4: §6§o"— Trial the Second. You made it through the dark without a map and without much sense, I'd wager. Good. The maze doesn't respect preparation. It respects stubbornness.§r§r
rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.desc.6: §6§o"You want to know about the Blade. Everyone does. Here is what I can tell you:§r§r
rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.desc.8: §6§o"I forged it to pass on. Not because I was generous — I'm not — but because I understood something most people don't: a weapon that stays in one hand goes dead. It needs new blood. New fights. New proof that it's worth carrying.§r§r
rad3q.2A340FEEA67FFAC5.title: Fragment II
rad3q.2A5FDC53A9A4B337.desc.0: You follow the glowing lanterns and wade into the shallows.
rad3q.2A5FDC53A9A4B337.desc.2: §9The wreck of the Harbinger§r lies half-buried in the sand, her hull split open by time and storm. Seaweed clings to the broken masts like mourning veils.
rad3q.2A5FDC53A9A4B337.desc.4: §o§8You've heard of this ship. Traders spoke of her captain — a privateer who turned pirate after being betrayed by the merchant guild. They say he went down with something valuable. Something people have been searching for ever since.§r§r
rad3q.2A5FDC53A9A4B337.title: The Wreck of the Harbinger

rad3q.2A9DC8C72AD9AED0.desc.6: §2Thank you for your understanding and sorry if something went wrong.§r

rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.12: - The Bandage is the average healing item with a respectable 12 uses, 0.5 hearts of healing and 0.5 second use time.
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.16: - The Medkit is a good replacement for all of the above, it lasts up to 50 uses, takes 1 second to use, retains 1 heart per use, but it requires all of the above plus some quartz and nether warts to craft!
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.2: - Lasts up to 5 uses, retains 0.5 hearts per use, 0.1 second use time
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.20: - The Enchanted Medkit is the best healing item in the mod, it lasts up to 50 uses (just like a normal medkit!), takes as long as a normal medkit to use, retains 1.5 hearts per use and gives absorption effect to the consumer, but requires a medkit, a golden apple and a ghast tear!
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.24: - The Estus Flask when crafted has 3 uses which can be increased using §6Estus Shards§r.
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.3: - Useful for quick burst healing in the middle of combat
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.30: Any item with regeneration effect (search in JEI)
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.7: - Lasts up to 7 uses, retains 0.75 hearts per use, 0.35 second use time
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.desc.8: - Less total healing than the bandage, but heals more in a short amount of time
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.subtitle: How am I supposed to heal?
rad3q.2AF1B6A89DD4F4C2.title: Healing Options

rad3q.2AF35E407C5E1153.desc.2: The dungeon tracks your §lkills§r, §lchests§r, and §ltime§r from the moment you enter. Exit through the portal to collect your §6Raid Tokens§r and XP.
rad3q.2AF35E407C5E1153.desc.4: §7Tip: dying doesn't end your run — you can re-enter and keep going. Exiting the portal finalizes run.

rad3q.2B0D09C6BDF6148D.desc.0: The king tells you the truth of it:
rad3q.2B0D09C6BDF6148D.desc.2: §6§o"The seal was placed by my own hand, centuries ago. I chose this. The throne is not a prison — it is a lock. What it contains must never be free."§r§r
rad3q.2B0D09C6BDF6148D.desc.4: §o§8To restore the seal you must bring what was used to forge it the first time: a fragment of enchanted obsidian, a diamond at its heart, and three golden seals — offerings once given by the king's court.§r§r
rad3q.2B0D09C6BDF6148D.desc.6: "§6§oDo this, and the desert will sleep again. You have my word — and my word has held for four hundred years."§r§r
rad3q.2B0D09C6BDF6148D.title: Restore the Ancient Seal

rad3q.2BD60874182BB807.subtitle: Piglins love this ring and will treat anyone wearing it as one of their own.
rad3q.2BFC57CBDF3A7C5D.desc.0: §6Pathfinder's Quill§r is a mystical instrument forged from the essence of ancient cartographers and enchanted with powerful magic.
rad3q.2BFC57CBDF3A7C5D.desc.2: Unlike the Adventurer’s Quill, which reveals the secrets of biomes, the Pathfinder’s Quill is your key to uncovering hidden and legendary §6structures§r scattered across the world.
rad3q.2BFC57CBDF3A7C5D.desc.4: With this quill in hand, you can trace the faintest echoes of lost temples, forgotten fortresses, and secret strongholds—each holding treasures, dangers, and stories long buried by time.
rad3q.2BFD9A8BD602BB0F.desc.0: The passage down from the settlement is wide and well-cut — or was. The dwarven lanterns have guttered out over the centuries.
rad3q.2BFD9A8BD602BB0F.desc.2: §o§8Your torches cast long shadows on walls that grow more elaborate the deeper you go. The geometric patterns have become something richer: scenes. Histories. A whole civilisation illustrated in bas-relief — dwarves founding their first forge, expanding their tunnels, discovering something vast and bright deep in the rock. The Vein, surely. In the early carvings they are celebrating it. Later, they are kneeling before it. Later still, they are running from it.§r§r
rad3q.2BFD9A8BD602BB0F.desc.4: The tunnel narrows. You hear something ahead — not the Vein, but something smaller.
rad3q.2BFD9A8BD602BB0F.desc.6: §2Scuffling. Muttering. The clink of things being handled carelessly.§r
rad3q.2BFD9A8BD602BB0F.desc.8: Goblins. Of course there are goblins.
rad3q.2BFD9A8BD602BB0F.title: Something in the Dark
rad3q.2C08D45277284F90.title: Logs
rad3q.2C0C2641BC5C7BB4.desc.10: Nephrite Fountains drain the Charge from Carved Nephrite it is placed on and converts it into XP orbs when it is powered with a redstone signal
rad3q.2C0C2641BC5C7BB4.desc.11: If a Nephrite Fountain is adjacent to charged Carved Nephrite, it can be right-clicked with a glass bottle and the charge will be exhanged for a bottle of XP
rad3q.2C0C2641BC5C7BB4.desc.14: - Nephrite Diodes take one charge from the Carved Nephrite behind it and transfer it to the Carved Nephrite in front of it whenever it receives a redstone signal
rad3q.2C0C2641BC5C7BB4.desc.15: - Diodes can be placed in any direction so the most useful thing they can do is transfer Charge vertically upward
rad3q.2C0C2641BC5C7BB4.desc.16: - Diodes can be pushed by pistons unlike the other components
rad3q.2C0C2641BC5C7BB4.desc.17: - A Redstone clock is required to make the best use of a Diode as it only transfers 1 Charge when it receives a signal
rad3q.2C0C2641BC5C7BB4.desc.2: Carved Nephrite is able to store experience inside itself in the form of "Charge" which it will equalize among neighboring Carved Nephrite. Charge will always prioritize flowing downward before checking to the side so keep that in mind when designing a storage vessel. Think of it like there's a fluid inside of the block. Each block of Carved Nephrite can store 100 Charge (just over 7 levels if you start from zero).
rad3q.2C0C2641BC5C7BB4.desc.6: Nephrite Siphons are used to convert XP into Charge by draining XP from players that stand on it or absorbing nearby XP orbs

rad3q.2C5E501FA26E92FF.desc.2: With each level of §4mastery§r you will gain access to new recipes. All trades are repeatable.
rad3q.2C5E501FA26E92FF.desc.4: §9Scrap§r is a knowledge points for this §4Mastery.§r It is needed for leveling up the §4Mastery§r for unlocking new trades.
rad3q.2C5E501FA26E92FF.desc.6: You can receive §9Scrap§r by processing some raw materials in §3Portable Mini Salvager§r, find it as loot or trade with Goblin Trader.

rad3q.2C8184EF50649550.desc.2: Note: Unlike the other rare drops, the Essence of Wind doesn't drop with the Magical Looting Charm equipped. You'll need to move 200m/s §othrough the air§r with Wind Capturing bottles in your inventory. Possible ways to achieve this:
rad3q.2C8184EF50649550.desc.3: - Shooting yourself out of a TNT cannon
rad3q.2C8184EF50649550.desc.5: - Getting knocked back by the Ender Dragon

rad3q.2C8184EF50649550.desc.7: - Casting Launch with a lot of Amplify on it

rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.0: Gear Upgrades are extra attributes for your gear.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.10: -Some upgrades will have "§eStable§r" or "§4Unstable§r" in the name. These can only be applied after 3 upgrades have already been equipped. After you will have to make a choice between a stable or unstable upgrade. §eStable§r upgrades are a simple, more powerful upgrade than regular upgrades. §4Unstable§r upgrades are more powerful than §eStable§r upgrades, but come with a strong drawback.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.12: -§eProficiency§r is gained on an item over time as you use the item to attack, mine, take damage, etc depending on the item. The §3Proficiency Cost§r of an upgrade will have yellow text if you can afford the cost.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.14: To apply an upgrade, combine the item with the upgrade's Item Cost in an anvil.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.16: To remove all gear upgrades from an item, combine the item with §aCrying Obsidian§r in an anvil.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.18: Furthermore, you can §6Limit Break§r an item to add 1 extra upgrade slot to the piece of equipment.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.19: To §6Limit Break§r an item, you will need 2 of the same item both with all gear upgrade slots filled and §eProficiency 100§r then combine both in an anvil.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.2: Hold §3Alt§r on an item that can accept gear upgrades will show all available upgrades that can be applied to that item.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.4: Hold §3Shift§r on the item to see all upgrades you have already equipped.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.6: Upgrades show the Name, Applicable Tiers, §eProficiency Cost§r, Experience Cost, and Item Cost in that order.
rad3q.2CCC9B49FB41B319.desc.8: -An item starts with 0 gear upgrades. Each time an upgrade is applied, the item's tier level is increased by 1. Some upgrades can only be applied when a specific number of gear upgrades are already applied. For example an upgrade with the Applicable Tiers [1, 2, 3] can be applied when there are 0, 1, or 2 upgrades already on the item. However an item with Applicable Tiers [4] can only be applied after 3 upgrades have been added before.

rad3q.303C9F12C46AB4A9.desc.0: As you approach the forest, a small, leather-wrapped bundle catches your eye at the foot of an ancient oak. Intrigued, you move closer.

rad3q.303C9F12C46AB4A9.desc.4: §o§9For the Blacksmith of Willow Creek. Deliver with haste.§r§r
rad3q.303C9F12C46AB4A9.desc.6: §o§8You recognize Willow Creek as a small village on the outskirts of the forest, home to a renowned blacksmith named Silas. You've heard tales of his skill, crafting weapons and armor of incredible strength.§r§r

rad3q.304845FA014A17D8.desc.2: It is enormous. Carved from a single piece of amber the size of a house, its surface cracked with age but still pulsing with a dim inner light.
rad3q.304845FA014A17D8.desc.4: §4Seated upon it — or rather, fused with it — is a figure that was once human. The ancient king.§r
rad3q.304845FA014A17D8.desc.6: §o§8Power radiates from the throne in waves. You could feel it from across the room. Whatever is stored inside this thing — centuries of offering, sacrifice, worship — it could be yours.§r§r
rad3q.304845FA014A17D8.desc.8: The only thing between you and it is whatever remains of the king.

rad3q.3587F64719C50EC7.desc.14: §5§o"...And it worked. I didn't think it would work."§r§r
rad3q.3587F64719C50EC7.desc.16: She hands you something — not gratitude, she's incapable of that — but something more useful.
rad3q.3587F64719C50EC7.desc.2: Not cleanly — not like Maren's ritual would have bound it. It tears apart, its essence scattering through the trees in ribbons of violet smoke. The corrupted hollow shudders and goes silent.
rad3q.3587F64719C50EC7.desc.4: §o§8The curse lifts. Not gently — it leaves all at once, like a held breath finally released. Your senses return in a rush: the smell of pine and wet earth, the sound of wind in the canopy overhead, the faint warmth of sunlight filtering through the branches.§r§r
rad3q.3587F64719C50EC7.desc.6: You're alive. The spirit is gone.
rad3q.3587F64719C50EC7.desc.8: Behind you, Maren steps out of the trees. For the first time, she looks something other than composed.
rad3q.3587F64719C50EC7.title: The Hard Way

rad3q.35B611772CD81F5E.desc.0: Medallion in hand, you press deeper.
rad3q.35B611772CD81F5E.desc.10: §4The door hums. The Vein, behind it, is still singing.
rad3q.35B611772CD81F5E.desc.2: The passage eventually opens into a vast underground chamber — the §6Deep Works.§r
rad3q.35B611772CD81F5E.desc.4: §o§8The scale is staggering. Forge-towers rise from the cavern floor to the distant ceiling, connected by walkways and ramps. Every surface is covered in carved symbols, but here they are inlaid with dark metal, and they still faintly §4glow§r. At the chamber's far end, a great sealed door — easily fifteen metres tall — bears the Forge-Masters' emblem enlarged a hundredfold.§r§r
rad3q.35B611772CD81F5E.desc.6: And in front of it, arranged in a semicircle, are the dwarves.
rad3q.35B611772CD81F5E.desc.8: §o§8They are not moving. Not dead, not exactly — preserved in a state between rest and stone. Their faces are peaceful. Each one faces the door. Each one holds a tool. They finished the job. They sealed The Vein. And then they stayed to make sure it held.§r§r
rad3q.35B611772CD81F5E.title: The Deep Works
rad3q.35D69DFDC6EB3272.subtitle: Crafted
rad3q.35D91F4E2BD7D32C.desc.0: A cow-like monster that spawns in plains and savannahs at night. Its attacks deal high knockback and apply Blindness and Slowness.
rad3q.35E7386440585F02.subtitle: Chapter: Fish n Farm
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.0: Book Wyrms adds Book Wyrms to your forests, §2lizards§r that come in a variety of colors. You can herd them for their meat and colorful scales, using plain books to breed them. Most importantly, you can feed them §ounwanted enchanted books§r to §drecycle§r them into new random enchanted books.
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.10: - §5Purple§r, can produce enchantments for some misc modded items
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.12: Additionally, Wyrms have genes that can be improved (or worsened) and passed on to future generations. Use the §dBook Wyrm Analyzer§r to see these stats and breed them strategically to obtain your perfects specimens. The following stats can be meddled with:
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.14: - §9Enchanting level§r, determines how many levels the Wyrm needs to digest before making a new book (stronger enchantments are worth more levels) and how strong are the enchantments it can produce
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.16: - §2Digesting speed§r, determines how fast does the Wyrm digests books
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.18: - §eIndigestion chance§r, determines how likely the Wyrm is to have an indigestion and regurgitate some shredded paper and (magical) digestive fluids
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.2: Wyrms come in 7 colors, each with a different pool of enchantments they can provide:
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.20: While the bonuses produced by indigestion may feel bad, they can be refed to recover part of the magic of the digested books, or made into Wyrmutagen. This substance will let you modify the stats of your Wyrm's offsprings to a much better degree, if you can make enough of it.
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.4: - §8Gray§r, most common, can produce any enchantment
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.5: - §4Red§r, can produce enchantments for melee weapons like Swords
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.6: - §6Orange§r, can produce enchantments for ranged weapons, like Bows or Crossbows
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.7: - §aGreen§r, can produce enchantments for tools, like Pickaxes or Shovels
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.8: - §1Blue§r, can produce enchantments for armor or Shields
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.desc.9: - §3Teal§r, can produce enchantments for Fishing Rods and Tridents
rad3q.35EA73868124C4C6.title: Book Wyrms
rad3q.35EDEA3061D1ADAC.desc.0: The longer you stand in the Vein's presence, the more you understand.
rad3q.35EDEA3061D1ADAC.desc.10: The door reseals behind you as you leave.
rad3q.35EDEA3061D1ADAC.desc.12: §o§8The dwarves are still at their posts. You think — you aren't certain — that one of them is smiling now.§r§r
rad3q.35EDEA3061D1ADAC.desc.2: §o§8Not in words — the Vein doesn't think in words. But in impressions. You see the dwarves finding it, millennia ago, and the joy of it. You see them building their civilisation around its warmth. You see the moment, generations later, when they realised the warmth was §4changing§r — pulling at them, drawing them inward, making it harder and harder to remember the surface.§r§r
rad3q.35EDEA3061D1ADAC.desc.4: §4The Vein was not trying to harm them. It simply wanted company.§r
rad3q.35EDEA3061D1ADAC.desc.6: §o§8But the Forge-Masters understood: something that cannot comprehend harm is still capable of causing it. So they built the seal. They stayed to hold it. And they sent the medallion away with a courier who never arrived.§r§r
rad3q.35EDEA3061D1ADAC.desc.8: You pry a single fragment from the vein wall. The crystal sings against your palm — a clear, high note, satisfied.
rad3q.35EDEA3061D1ADAC.title: A Piece of Something Ancient
rad3q.35FED99D71DA1A18.desc.0: You drop into a mineshaft — a routine descent, torches already placed by whoever dug here before you.
rad3q.35FED99D71DA1A18.desc.2: But thirty blocks down, the wooden supports stop. The tunnel walls change: no longer rough-hewn dirt, but §6dressed stone§r, carved with a precision no modern miner could match.
rad3q.35FED99D71DA1A18.desc.4: §o§8Someone else was here first. Long before the mineshaft. Long before anyone living can remember. The stonework is immaculate — each block fitted without mortar, smooth as glass. Geometric symbols run along the ceiling in a repeating pattern, worn but still legible to someone who knows what to look for.§r§r
rad3q.35FED99D71DA1A18.desc.6: You don't know what to look for. But you know this didn't come from nothing.
rad3q.35FED99D71DA1A18.title: Something Older Beneath
rad3q.35FF4B7936D61998.title: Defeat the drowned crew

rad3q.373262E31E3E4D5B.desc.0: Dimensional Dungeons adds limitless procedurally generated dungeons to Minecraft! These dungeons are all placed in a single, separate dimension which can be accessed from a portal anywhere on the Overworld. This makes the dungeons themselves renewable and it provides challenging, replayable content.
rad3q.373262E31E3E4D5B.desc.2: The dungeon dimension limits building and block breaking. This allows for a proper adventure mode-like experience.
rad3q.373262E31E3E4D5B.desc.4: §cThe monsters in the dungeon are very strong, much stronger than any you would normally encounter.§r Their numbers, and your lack of options for dealing with them, make the dungeons very difficult. That is why the keys are so hard to craft! §cMake sure you're prepared for a tough fight before you enter one.§r
rad3q.373262E31E3E4D5B.desc.6: Besides challenging monsters, the dungeons are also full of worthwhile loot! Many rooms with valuable treasure chests require solving a puzzle that will test your knowledge of Minecraft game mechanics.
rad3q.375994C478ED20DF.desc.0: The core of the mod is its mechanics, which add new ways to attack and defend. These are intended to supplement the vanilla combat system, and make new playstyles viable. If you aren't sure how to get started, a patchouli guidebook is available, crafted with a book and gold sword.
rad3q.375994C478ED20DF.title: Combat Mechanics

rad3q.37EFC27EA5A642AC.desc.0: Gives you more loot, but raises the difficulty. Raising the difficulty can be good, since it lets mobs with new, powerful traits spawn. High risk, high reward.
rad3q.37EFC27EA5A642AC.subtitle: I want more
rad3q.38037091D6488B24.subtitle: Burning enchantments
rad3q.38049609F73B874B.desc.0: Mobs now have a chance to spawn as Champions, elite mobs with enhanced stats, extra abilities, and extra loot (Enchanted Books and Coins).
rad3q.38049609F73B874B.desc.2: Champions have affixes that grant them powers, with higher tiers having more affixes.
rad3q.38049609F73B874B.desc.4: There are currently 6 tiers of Champions, locked behind game stages.
rad3q.38049609F73B874B.desc.9: For information on what coins which tiers drop, check out the Coin Shop!
rad3q.38049609F73B874B.subtitle: Elite Mobs
rad3q.380CDF37C30FB86A.desc.0: A friendly creature that can be found in mineshafts. It likes to play hide and seek. Find it 3 times and it will give you a gift.
rad3q.381F497D537D074D.desc.0: With determination in your heart, you decide to use the map to locate the bandits' hideout, which is said to be hidden deep underground. The clues you've gathered from the blacksmith, cook, and cleric guide you as you embark on this crucial mission.
rad3q.381F497D537D074D.desc.2: The map indicates that the entrance to the hideout is concealed in a remote area, possibly covered by natural foliage or hidden within a rocky outcrop.
rad3q.381F497D537D074D.title: Find Illager Hideout
rad3q.38244A01FB371C21.title: §9Apprentice Level Scavenging§r
rad3q.382FD79EE64EA346.desc.0: What do these hooded specters guard... or who?
rad3q.382FD79EE64EA346.subtitle: Bigger than a Castle Ruin
rad3q.382FD79EE64EA346.title: Ruined Castle
rad3q.383426FBF6B0B4D3.desc.0: Following the direction the merchant came from, you find the first signs of ancient civilisation:
rad3q.383426FBF6B0B4D3.desc.2: §6Sandstone columns§r, half-buried. Carved reliefs showing figures bowing to a great seated form — a ruler, crowned in amber, surrounded by kneeling armies.
rad3q.383426FBF6B0B4D3.desc.4: §o§8The ruins stretch further than you expected. A civilisation must have thrived here once, before the desert swallowed everything. But why did they carve their king's image on every surface with such reverence? And why, in every depiction, do the worshippers have their eyes closed — as if they dared not look directly at the throne?§r§r
rad3q.383426FBF6B0B4D3.desc.6: The ruins are crawling with undead. §4They shouldn't be this far from a crypt.
rad3q.383426FBF6B0B4D3.title: The Buried Columns
rad3q.38344BDD1AA29488.desc.0: The Captain Revenant can be found in damaged villages full of lesser revenants. It is the second miniboss of Icaria.
rad3q.383D2BC86F4BD090.title: Amplified Nether
rad3q.38BB179D3890CEA5.title: Alright but don't come cryin' to me.
rad3q.38CA2285DA8C510D.desc.0: If you have a lot of items to recycle:
rad3q.38CA2285DA8C510D.desc.4: - dump everything you want to recycle into the chest
rad3q.38CA2285DA8C510D.desc.5: - right-click on a §9Task Screen§r block, click 'Task' and start typing 'Recycling...'

rad3q.39009F5BF2A833D0.desc.0: All disenchanting works the same way: hold the book or tome in your §eMAIN HAND§r, the enchanted item in your §eOFFHAND§r, and right-click. A §5Soul Jar§r with enough souls just needs to be §fsomewhere in your inventory§r - you don't have to hold it.
rad3q.39009F5BF2A833D0.desc.2: The §bBook of Disenchant (Lesser)§r costs §f1 soul§r and strips §f1-2 random§r enchantments onto separate books. The book itself isn't consumed - only the souls are spent (unless mastery conserves them, see §6The Long Climb§r). There is a small chance that ritual §cfails§r: 35%%.
rad3q.39009F5BF2A833D0.desc.4: The target item is never destroyed, whatever gets stripped comes back as loose enchanted books.
rad3q.39009F5BF2A833D0.subtitle: Cheap, a little unreliable
rad3q.39009F5BF2A833D0.title: Lesser Disenchantment
rad3q.392C1055DFA53518.subtitle: Enter a pipeline but beware the sentry blazes
rad3q.392C1149DCB09A4D.desc.0: you ate the eyeball, didn't you
rad3q.3946D284196ECF5E.desc.0: §7§oAfter purchasing info about your inventory from 3rd party sellers we have sent another associate nearby on the surface with §fpersonalized offers§7 we believe are tailored to your interests!
rad3q.3946D284196ECF5E.desc.2: §7§oAct fast, our offer will §r§lexpire in 10 minutes!§r
rad3q.3946D284196ECF5E.desc.4: §7§oWe have equipped this trader with state-of-the-art "thorns" zombie defense mechanisms in case of unfortunate timing of our associate's arrival. We are not responsible for any deaths caused by accidentally pre-emptively activating this system.§r
rad3q.3946D284196ECF5E.desc.6: §7§oIf you would like us to not buy or sell your personal information please respond with another stack of §r§bDiamonds.§r
rad3q.3946D284196ECF5E.subtitle: §3From:§r §6The Traveling Salesman League§r
rad3q.3946D284196ECF5E.title: Personalized Offers
rad3q.394D7906EC60F5BD.desc.0: A weathered merchant collapses at the edge of a desert trading post, barely alive.
rad3q.394D7906EC60F5BD.desc.2: Before losing consciousness, he presses a cracked clay tablet into your hands.
rad3q.394D7906EC60F5BD.desc.4: §6§o"The Amber Throne... don't let them wake it... the seal is broken..."§r§r
rad3q.394D7906EC60F5BD.desc.6: §o§8The tablet is covered in glyphs you've never seen before. The merchant is beyond help — whatever he faced in the desert took everything he had. But the tablet feels significant. Heavy. Wrong.§r§r
rad3q.394D7906EC60F5BD.desc.8: You look east. The dunes stretch endlessly. Something out there broke that man.
rad3q.394D7906EC60F5BD.title: The Dying Merchant
rad3q.3953AFE08C194E79.desc.0: The highest level an Enchanting Table can reach is §6Level 100§r, but only one shelf can provide this much power. Creating such a shelf requires venturing into the outer end to retrieve a §5Dragon Head§r.
rad3q.3953AFE08C194E79.desc.2: §5Dragon Heads§r spawn on end ships. You can also find one in the library of an §bAviary§r or simply craft it from dragon scales.
rad3q.3953AFE08C194E79.desc.4: A single §dDraconic Endshelf§r provides enough raw strength to boost a table from Level 80 to Level 100. However, it provides no other stat bonuses.
rad3q.3953AFE08C194E79.subtitle: Reaching Level 100
rad3q.3961149BA240E2BE.title: Enter Quartz Flats Biome
rad3q.3973C07FBF620DB6.desc.0: A huge, hanging, ancient brick structure full of phantoms. At the bottom of the four honey pools is a piece of deepslate diamond ore.
rad3q.3973C07FBF620DB6.subtitle: Find a Phantom Aviary
rad3q.398136BC6E7CB1BE.desc.0: Can be placed on top of sticks to create a flagpole. Right-click a flagpole to raise the flag, hold sneak to lower it.
rad3q.398136BC6E7CB1BE.title: Flags
rad3q.39939BF03332602B.desc.0: While exploring and looting chests, you come across some §3worn and tattered paper fragments§r - remnants of what once was a map, lost to time. Intrigued by their potential, you decide to seek out someone knowledgeable who might help you piece together their meaning.
rad3q.39939BF03332602B.desc.2: Perhaps the §6Cartographer§r or the §6Librarian§r in town can shed light on these ancient scraps.
rad3q.39939BF03332602B.title: Investigate the mysterious map fragments
rad3q.39940935CF99B3B0.desc.0: These boots will automine many kinds of wood, beehive, honeycomb blocks that you are standing on when you look down and hold crouch while standing in center of the block!
rad3q.39940935CF99B3B0.desc.2: The boots can be enchanted with the normal boot enchantments but can also be enchanted with Efficiency, Silk Touch, and Fortune. To go with Efficiency, the boots also mines faster when you have the full bee armor set on or have Beenergized status effect. These mining speed boosts do stack.
rad3q.39940935CF99B3B0.desc.4: The boots will also let you briefly hang on walls made of wood, beehive, or honeycomb blocks allowing you to wall jump or wall run!
rad3q.39940935CF99B3B0.desc.6: Can be repaired by Honeycomb, Leather, Wool, or Rabbit Hide.
rad3q.39940935CF99B3B0.subtitle: Found in Cell Maze structure and comes in 2 variants.
rad3q.39940935CF99B3B0.title: Bee Boots
rad3q.39C0CB52F511D9CB.title: Retrieve the sealed crate from the captain's quarters
rad3q.39C49F2F329A1CC3.desc.0: A vine-wrapped structure built by a long-lost civilization.
rad3q.39C49F2F329A1CC3.subtitle: Find a Jungle Monument
rad3q.39C49F2F329A1CC3.title: Jungle Monument
rad3q.39CE66AC4B1DC621.desc.0: A legendary tool coveted by explorers and treasure hunters alike, the §2Adventurer's Quill§r is imbued with ancient magic that reveals the hidden wonders of the world.
rad3q.39CE66AC4B1DC621.desc.2: When wielded, it grants its bearer the power to locate specific biomes—those rare and extraordinary landscapes that hold unique resources, secrets, and challenges.
rad3q.39CE66AC4B1DC621.desc.4: Whether you seek the dense, mysterious jungles, the arid, sun-baked deserts, or the frosty, snow-covered tundras, the Adventurer's Quill will guide your path with unerring precision.
rad3q.39D58FB022CA52F1.subtitle: Digital Fortification
rad3q.39D58FB022CA52F1.title: §bVirtual Gold Armor Set§r

rad3q.39F87D8D27C27229.title: Trait Shop I
rad3q.39FFF3DDA03C40EF.desc.0: Accessing the penultimate tier requires a Level 80 table and access to §dDragon's Breath§r. With these, you can create Infused Dragon's Breath, a core component of §eEndshelves§r.
rad3q.39FFF3DDA03C40EF.subtitle: Reaching Level 90

rad3q.3A1250C40DD39D2C.desc.0: Once a home of prestige, now a hollow shell of memories.
rad3q.3A1250C40DD39D2C.subtitle: Explore the decaying elegance of the past.

rad3q.3A596043B1D5950A.title: Advanced Tokens
rad3q.3A77039D6CAB3BB1.desc.2: §o§8He is slow — four centuries of immobility will do that — but he is §bimmensely strong§r. And the throne feeds him. Every time you push him back, the amber light flares and his wounds close.§r§r
rad3q.3A77039D6CAB3BB1.desc.4: You realise quickly: you cannot kill him while he touches the throne.
rad3q.3A77039D6CAB3BB1.desc.6: §4You must break the throne first. Then him.
rad3q.3A77039D6CAB3BB1.title: Claim the Throne's Power
rad3q.3A9272D0C456214D.desc.0: Archers are skilled bowmen. Generally independent and used to working alone, this tends to make them practical, a little haughty or arrogant and not the best at following orders, especially from those they don't respect. Due to the nature of their weapon, archers are typically stealthy and graceful and tend to fight at a distance. As a result, they're often portrayed as vulnerable to close-quarters combat unless they switch to a different weapon.
rad3q.3A94FB210F4C4CCA.title: Building Blocks
rad3q.3AB137C13FE59AEA.subtitle: Who lives here?
rad3q.3AB137C13FE59AEA.title: Old Home
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.desc.0: The §bMatter Recycler§r is a powerful tool used to deconstruct bulk materials into raw essence.
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.desc.12: • §bGranular§r §bProcessing:§r The machine processes the entire stack at once, but calculates success for §bevery§r §bitem§r individually. One bad roll won't ruin the whole stack!
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.desc.14: • §bJam§r §bChance:§r There is a base §b10%%§r §bchance§r per item to jam. If a jam occurs, the machine enters a §b10§r §bsecond§r §bcooldown§r to clear its internal gears.
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.desc.16: • §dJackpot§r §dYields:§r Recycling §bDiamonds§r, §bNetherite§r, or §bGems§r can trigger a §dJackpot§r, awarding rare §bApotheosis§r §bGems§r or massive §bXP§r bursts.
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.desc.18: Use a §bRecycling Journal§r to track your progress. As your §bMastery Tier§r increases, you will nearly eliminate jams and significantly boost your §dJackpot§r rates.
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.desc.4: • Place the item(s) you wish to recycle in your §bOffhand§r.
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.desc.6: • Hold the Recycler in your §bMain Hand§r and §bRight-Click§r.
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.desc.8: • Currently, this process is §bfree§r of XP costs, as the machine extracts energy from the items themselves.
rad3q.3AC71E8812CDFD93.title: §bThe Matter Recycler§r
rad3q.3AF1E410BB35E75A.title: Underground Catacombs
rad3q.3AF6284A78CE01BC.desc.0: You find a dead crow on your path, pinned to a tree with a silver needle.
rad3q.3AF6284A78CE01BC.desc.2: A small note tied to its leg reads:
rad3q.3AF6284A78CE01BC.desc.4: §5§o"The pact is broken. Come to the §2Hawthorn Circle§r§5§o before the next full moon, or the curse spreads. You know what you did."§r§r
rad3q.3AF6284A78CE01BC.desc.6: §o§8You don't remember making any pact. But you notice, with some unease, that you can no longer smell anything. The curse has already begun.§r§r
rad3q.3AF6284A78CE01BC.title: The Crow's Warning
rad3q.3B33674AB3EBE3C0.title: Common Hat Bag
rad3q.3B56BB644C301EA4.title: Cleanse the nesting passages
rad3q.3B62486F60D527E7.desc.2: This is the only way to obtain Unbreaking 10.
rad3q.3B62486F60D527E7.subtitle: Unbreaking+
rad3q.3B713701E442645A.desc.0: §aExperience§r is your most valuable currency in this world. Dying means losing that hard-earned progress, so tread carefully and make sure you prioritize gaining §aexperience§r over reckless §4risk-taking§r.
rad3q.3B713701E442645A.desc.7: - usual vanilla mechanics - mining, breeding, trading, fishing, grindstones and furnaces
rad3q.3B713701E442645A.title: Experience
rad3q.3B822759AA2551D5.desc.0: Gravity is merely a suggestion in the home of the Shulkers.
rad3q.3B822759AA2551D5.subtitle: Scale the towers of the outer islands.

rad3q.3BB7AECAAE68AED1.desc.10: §o§8You look at the three fragments in your hand. Separated, they're scraps. Held together, they form half a map — the other half is in your memory now, assembled from the ruins and the water and the dark.§r§r
rad3q.3BB7AECAAE68AED1.desc.12: §4A place where the boundary is thin.§r You know what that means. Find somewhere the dead walk.
rad3q.3BB7AECAAE68AED1.desc.2: §o§8Same ritual. Vial. Parchment. But this one smells different — saltwater and something older underneath it, like air that hasn't moved in centuries.§r§r
rad3q.3BB7AECAAE68AED1.desc.4: §6§o"— Trial the Third. Good. You're wet, you're cold, and you're still here. That's the whole test, honestly. The maze and the crypt are just to thin the crowd.§r§r
rad3q.3BB7AECAAE68AED1.desc.6: §6§o"I'm not dead. I want to be clear about that. I'm somewhere further down than dead — past the roots of things, past where light gives up. But I can still hear it when someone passes my trials. I've been hearing it less and less. Good to hear it again.§r§r
rad3q.3BB7AECAAE68AED1.desc.8: §6§o"Bring the three pages together. Say my name at a place where the boundary is thin. I'll find you."§r§r

rad3q.400F579D0850605B.desc.0: An offensively-focused spellcaster who lacks some of the weaknesses of their setting's normal Squishy Wizards - they're tougher and can cast their spells faster or more reliably, in exchange for their arsenal being weaker or limited entirely to offense. Explanations for this can vary from special training, to special equipment, to their magic being somehow "artificial". Usually has at least a mild military theme, being either a soldier (possibly a Super Soldier) or someone who Had to Be Sharp. Tends to use spells with shorter ranges than other spellcasters, or to simply cast their spells at close range more often. Can sometimes equip better weapons or armor than other mages, in which case they're distinguished from the Magic Knight through poor physical stats or lack of advanced combat skills.

rad3q.449D184873EBA2C5.desc.5: - §2Scrolls of Knowledge§r can store all your experience at once. However, not only do they require a grave soul, but they're also single-use. You can't store anything less than the full amount either. I don't recommend this one.

Using a higher tier backpack and stack upgrades can increase the storage size. Ultimately, I like this one the best.

rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.0: With Apotheosis, enchanting is dependent on more than just levels. There are currently five new enchanting stats. Blocks that provide enchanting stats will have them on their tooltip.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.10: §cQuanta§r is a secondary stat. It controls enchanting variance. During enchanting, you have a §6Base Power§r, which is the level you spent to enchant with, and then a §5Final Power§r, after all modifications. §cQuanta§r is one of the factors in the modification process.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.12: A value is selected, between 1 - §cQuanta§r and 1 + §cQuanta§r.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.13: Your §5Final Power§r is equal to that value multiplied by your §6Base Power§r. Higher §cQuanta§r values increase the power range, which means your enchantments are less consistent in their §5Final Power§r.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.18: §5Arcana§r is a secondary stat. It controls the rarity weights, and at certain thresholds will guarantee you get additional enchantments. At 25%% §5Arcana§r, you will always receive at least two enchantments. At 75%%, you will always receive three.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.20: By default, the rarities have the following weights:
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.26: Every 10%% of §5Arcana§r changes the weights, eventually becoming fully inverted. Hovering the §5Arcana§r Bar will show the current weights.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.31: §eRectification§r is a tertiary stat. It directly impacts the lower bound of §cQuanta§r modifications. Recall that your §4Min Power§r is equal to 1 - §cQuanta§r. With Rectification (R), your §4Min Power§r is equal to 1 - (1 - R) * §cQuanta§r.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.33: If that doesn't make a ton of sense, don't worry about it. Just know that higher §eRectification§r values are always a good thing. You can also have §4negative§r §eRectification§r, which is always bad.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.39: §8Clues§r are another tertiary stat. Each clue allows you to see one additional item in the preview window. When you can see every available enchantment, the text will change slightly.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.4: §aEterna§r is the primary stat of enchanting. Each point of §aEterna§r increases the maximum enchanting level by two. Some blocks can only provide §aEterna§r up to a certain maximum value.
rad3q.4A498CD14AEEE7E9.desc.41: You can also drop to zero clues, and be able to see nothing.

rad3q.4ADB9500DDDE28EA.desc.0: Finally, through the smoke and dust, you see him: §4Krag§r, his scarred face twisted in a mask of rage. He charges, his blade a blur of steel. The clash is fierce, a whirlwind of blades and blood. You parry his attacks, your own blade finding its mark again and again. You fight with a ferocity born of desperation, fueled by a growing sense of vengeance.
rad3q.4ADB9500DDDE28EA.desc.2: In a final, desperate lunge, you disarm §4Krag§r, your blade finding its way to his heart. He collapses, his eyes wide with disbelief.
rad3q.4ADB9500DDDE28EA.desc.4: The fight is over. Silence descends upon the clearing, broken only by the ragged breaths of the survivors. You stand amidst the carnage, your heart pounding, your hands trembling. You've won, but at a terrible cost. You've slain Krag, the leader of the bandits, and claimed his sword, a symbol of your triumph and a reminder of the darkness you've embraced.

rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.desc.10: §6§o"I name you bearer of the Questing Blade. Not owner — there are no owners. Bearer. It passes through hands, not into them. You hold it, you use it, you prove it was worth forging. Then you come back for another. That's the deal."§r§r
rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.desc.12: §o§8He extends one hand. The gesture is formal. Practiced. He's done this before — or tried to — and never got this far.§r§r
rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.desc.14: §6§o"The Wandering Hold will know your name. Bring it proof of a dungeon run — any run, one of the crates — and it'll give you a fresh blade. Lose it, break it, throw it into a volcano. Come back. The Hold endures."§r§r
rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.desc.18: §6§o"My spirit drifts further down these days. Toward the roots of things. Deeper than this world goes, almost. If you ever find your way to such depths — look for a compass rose carved into the dark."§r§r
rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.desc.2: §o§8Silence. The kind that follows violence — thick and particular.§r§r
rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.desc.4: Desram's shape recongeals from the shadows. He considers you for a long moment.
rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.desc.6: §6§o"Three trials. Three crates. Three fragments of something that most people would have given up on by now. And here you are, covered in whatever that last thing was, §nstill standing.§r§r"
rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.desc.8: §o§8He moves to stand in front of you.§r§r
rad3q.4DF386E8ED4C6E8D.title: The Oath
rad3q.4E3787464BABD948.desc.0: Allows crafting of skeleton decorations from bone blocks.

rad3q.4E816C3883966AE9.desc.0: Dual Wielding allows you to use a weapon from your offhand. Parry This! uses a unique implementation of dual wield. Instead of using right click to trigger an offhand attack, you will alternate between your main and off hands by attacking normally. Dual wielding grants a small boost in attack speed, as well as a penalty for using weapons with differing speeds. Some weapons are marked as "two handed", and cannot be used for dual wielding.

rad3q.4EAB0F8461B6B3C4.desc.0: Paragliding is probably one of the easiest and convenient method of getting around, after running of course.
rad3q.4EAB0F8461B6B3C4.desc.2: All you need is Paraglider and a bit of stamina.
rad3q.4EAB0F8461B6B3C4.desc.4: You can increase your stamina with Stamina Vessels.
rad3q.4EAB0F8461B6B3C4.desc.6: Can ride ascending wind to gain height! Look out for rising particles while holding the Paraglider.
rad3q.4EB30556810264B2.desc.0: A monster that spawns in snowy biomes. It attacks with damaging snowballs. It heals while touching snow. It can freeze water it walks across.
rad3q.4ECC6D216E912D3F.desc.0: These magma creatures spawn in magma pools deep underground and in the Nether. They throw fireballs like Blazes and leave a trail of fire behind them. They are afraid of Striders and will leave players alone if they are riding one.

If you store or use your §2experience§r, you won't lose hearts. But you §nwon't gain§r any additional §chearts§r until you go over your previous maximum again.

rad3q.4F79C7F70109F97A.desc.0: The broker holds up a dark iron ingot.
rad3q.4F79C7F70109F97A.desc.10: §6§o"Bring me what the dead leave behind. I'll give you what the living need."§r§r
rad3q.4F79C7F70109F97A.desc.2: §6§o"You've been in the graveyards. I can tell. This metal comes out of the same places Desram's crew guard."§r§r
rad3q.4F79C7F70109F97A.desc.4: §o§8He sets it on the scales. It weighs more than it should.§r§r
rad3q.4F79C7F70109F97A.desc.6: §6§o"Desram called it the §nspectral tithe.§r§6§o The undead don't spend coin, but they carry things from the world they came from. Things the living can use. He said it was the only honest tax he ever collected — the dead don't haggle."§r§r
rad3q.4F79C7F70109F97A.desc.8: §o§8The broker adds a second entry to the ledger. A standing arrangement, below the others — smaller print, like it was added as an afterthought.§r§r
rad3q.4F79C7F70109F97A.title: Spectral Tithe
rad3q.4F97DCE67B0AF101.desc.0: §eSneak + right-click§r the Soul Jar (main hand) to open a full status readout in chat:
rad3q.4F97DCE67B0AF101.desc.2: §7- Souls stored, current capacity, and mastery rank
rad3q.4F97DCE67B0AF101.desc.3: §7- A progress bar toward your next rank
rad3q.4F97DCE67B0AF101.desc.6: §7- Every perk's current live chance, or how many souls until it unlocks

rad3q.4FFE28F3DB5EC162.desc.0: There are multiple methods to perform disenchanting.
rad3q.4FFE28F3DB5EC162.desc.2: §5Tome of Scrapping§r costs a few levels, destroys the item, and returns half the enchantments, rounded up, on a book.
rad3q.4FFE28F3DB5EC162.desc.4: §5Tome of Superior Scrapping§r costs a lot of levels, destroys the item, but returns all of the enchantments.
rad3q.4FFE28F3DB5EC162.title: Extracting Enchantments
rad3q.500559C4EC48DAE9.desc.0: Despite the similar-looking tooltip, the Abrahadabra is far more powerful than the Ring of Reflection. The Abrahadabra gives you immunity to (almost) all traits. Pulling, Repelling, Killer Aura, Ragnarok, they all do nothing to you. Reprint, though, still hurts.
rad3q.5005C51CA1B68CC3.desc.0: Backstab is a powerful special attack that can be performed by attacking a target from behind. It's hard to hit, but if you get your aim right, you can deal 300%% damage to your target. Combined with vanilla stealth mechanics, such as sneaking and invisibility, a rouge or ninja playstyle becomes practical. In pvp, backstabs are practically impossible if your enemy knows you are coming, so use stealth to your advantage. Backstab works with both melee and ranged attacks, making sniping possible as well. Backstab only affects targets with 20 max health or less by default.
rad3q.50636F87241A3723.desc.0: §o§7I saw your soul slip away for a moment, traveler. Luckily for you, your story isn't over yet.§r
rad3q.50636F87241A3723.desc.2: §o§7Death is cold and disorienting. Your belongings are still lying where you fell, but they won't wait forever. Pick yourself up and go get them.§r
rad3q.50636F87241A3723.desc.4: §o§7I’ve guided you back this once. Don't expect me to be so generous next time.§r
rad3q.50636F87241A3723.subtitle: §3From:§r §o§4The Caretaker of Souls§r§r
rad3q.50636F87241A3723.title: A Toll Not Yet Paid
rad3q.50751D78FFE7BD1C.desc.0: Technically this is a boss? Not what you'd expect the final boss of the Bumblezone to be, but hey, I'll take it.
rad3q.50751D78FFE7BD1C.desc.2: §oHolding this item in offhand will make dying not kill you and instead teleport you back to your respawn point with all health restored, hunger bar filled, neutral and negative status effects removed, and fire removed. Will work in hardcore worlds too!§r

rad3q.519D24DCF148C17C.desc.3: §oHolding this item in offhand while being in a spot with sky brightness 13 or above (basically in view of the sky) will grant you Regeneration 1, Saturation 1, Speed 1, Haste 2, and Damage Resistance 2. It will also slowly heal your armor durability as well over time!§r

rad3q.51F2FDBFFC5C087A.desc.0: From somewhere that doesn't quite exist, a sword arrives.
rad3q.51F2FDBFFC5C087A.desc.10: In your pack: the Blade. In the world: more dungeons, more crates, more proof to gather.
rad3q.51F2FDBFFC5C087A.desc.4: §o§8It looks like a sword. Feels like one too — solid, balanced, made to be used rather than admired. But there's something in the grip that isn't quite weight. A sense of accumulation. Every hand that's held this, every trial it's witnessed. It remembers.§r§r
rad3q.51F2FDBFFC5C087A.desc.6: §6§o"When you lose it — and you will — you know where to find me."§r§r
rad3q.51F2FDBFFC5C087A.desc.8: §o§8The voice comes from nowhere and everywhere at once. You look up. Desram is gone. §r§r
rad3q.51F2FDBFFC5C087A.title: The First Blade
rad3q.51FE59E362FBA2BA.desc.0: For some reason there is a disco club in the Bumblezone. You can find a special record here.

rad3q.52FEA7C8BC5C31DA.desc.0: With the corrupted creatures slain and the components gathered, Maren performs the ritual at the Hawthorn Circle.
rad3q.52FEA7C8BC5C31DA.desc.2: §2The fire burns green, then white.§r The carved symbols on the stones glow and fade. You feel something leave you — a cold, clammy presence that you hadn't noticed until it was gone.
rad3q.52FEA7C8BC5C31DA.desc.4: §o§8Maren stands and brushes ash from her coat. "The curse is lifted. The spirit is bound." She reaches into her cloak and produces a small vial — deep green, swirling with something alive.§r§r
rad3q.52FEA7C8BC5C31DA.desc.8: The forest smells like pine again.
rad3q.52FEA7C8BC5C31DA.title: The Pact Fulfilled
rad3q.5300718DDDE89FD4.desc.10: "Help me finish the ritual and the curse lifts. Refuse and... it won't."
rad3q.5300718DDDE89FD4.desc.2: You turn to find a woman watching you from the tree line — old, sharp-eyed, wrapped in layers of dried herbs and dark cloth. She doesn't look surprised to see you.
rad3q.5300718DDDE89FD4.desc.4: §5§o"So the curse found its mark. Good. That means the ritual worked — at least in part."§r§r
rad3q.5300718DDDE89FD4.desc.6: §o§8She introduces herself as §5Maren§r§o§8, a hedge-witch who has been tracking a corrupted nature spirit for months. She needed an §2anchor§r for her binding ritual — a living person whose name the forest could attach itself to. She chose you, a stranger passing through.§r§r
rad3q.5300718DDDE89FD4.desc.8: "I apologise for the inconvenience," she says, not apologetically at all.
rad3q.5300718DDDE89FD4.title: Maren the Hedge-Witch
rad3q.533001DF566AB5A6.desc.0: This pack uses the 1.18 features to create brand new terrain in the Nether - with 3D biomes and tons of new terrain types.
rad3q.533001DF566AB5A6.desc.2: It also brings back the Nether mountains from the original Nether Update trailer. Many players saw these and were upset that they weren't in the game - we've added them for you to enjoy!
rad3q.533001DF566AB5A6.desc.4: 3D biomes are used extensively as well - you might find a different biome at the base of a mountain than at the top, and you'll find much more biome variation in normal Nether terrain. Biome borders that were previously impossible are now commonplace - any biome can border any other biome!
rad3q.533001DF566AB5A6.subtitle: 256 blocks tall Nether
rad3q.533D8472E093176E.desc.0: Slime monsters that spawn at night in swamps and mangrove swamps. They regenerate when wet. Their attacks afflict Slowness II. When they die, they split into 2 tiny Magical Slimes.

rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.10: - §9Moonwalk:§r mobs and players around it will have lower gravity, falling slower and jumping higher
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.11: - §3Counter Strike:§r when the mob is attacked, after it lands on ground, it will attempt to dash-strike back, launching itself toward target.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.19: - §3Adaptive:§r Mobs will get memorize and get used to damage types. Higher level allows mobs to memorize more damage types
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.2: - §3Fiery:§r Mobs can ignite you when attacked or attack you.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.20: - §9Reflect:§r Mobs will reflect direct physical damage. Try to use arrow or magic.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.21: - §3Grenade:§r Shoot explosive bullet every few seconds after the previous bullet disappears.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.22: - §9Growth:§r Slime only. Slime will grow larger when healed to full health. Growth III slime can be very large.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.23: - §3Split:§r Mobs will split into 2 with half level and same trait (with 1 level lower split trait) when killed. Subsequent mobs won't drop anything.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.24: - §9Drain:§r Mobs will remove random positive potion effects, and increase duration of negative effects on target. Deals more damage if target has negative effects.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.25: - §3Reprint:§r When hit target, copy target equipment enchantments. Increase damage based on target total enchantment points
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.26: - §9Corrosion:§r Appears only after Lv.200. When mob hit target, it will consume target equipment durability based on lost durability. Use Hardened enchantment to mitigate this effect.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.27: - §3Erosion:§r Appears only after Lv.200. When mob hit target, it will consume target equipment durability based on remaining durability. Use Hardened enchantment to mitigate this effect.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.3: - §9Invisible:§r Mobs and their armors/weapons will become invisible. Use Detector Glass to see them.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.47: §oThese traits will only be unlocked when you kills a mob with Rank 5 traits, and appear only after Lv.100§r
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.49: - §4Dementor:§r Mobs will be immune to physical attack, and their damage will bypass armor
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.50: - §6Dispelling:§r Mobs will be immune to magic attack, and their damage will bypass magical protections. They can also disable enchantments on your equipments for a short time
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.51: - §4Teleport:§r Mobs can teleport to avoid physical damage. Try to use magic.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.52: - §6Repelling:§r Mobs will repel you. Use full set insulation enchantment to reduce the force.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.53: - §4Pulling:§r Mobs will pull you toward it. Use full set insulation enchantment to reduce the force.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.54: - §6Master:§r Mobs will summon allies. This trait is only found on special bosses.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.55: - §4Killer Aura:§r Appears only after Lv.300. Mobs will deal damage to nearby targets every few seconds, range indicated by particle effects.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.56: - §6Ragnarok:§r Appears only after Lv.600. When mob hit target, mob will "seal" some equipments or curios on target, which can be unsealed by hold using the item for a few seconds.
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.6: - §9Speedy:§r Mobs will move at absurd speed
rad3q.544FFD8F98E83BED.desc.7: - §3Tank:§r Mobs will gain much more health and armor

rad3q.545FD79030CAC86C.desc.0: The kettle is a very confusing block. Here is a step by step guide on how to use it.
rad3q.545FD79030CAC86C.desc.2: 1. Fill the kettle with a bucket of Medeterranian Water.
rad3q.545FD79030CAC86C.desc.4: 2. Acquire a scroll from looting villages. Hold the scroll in your hand. Look at what ingredients it is asking for.
rad3q.545FD79030CAC86C.desc.6: 3. Gather each of those ingredients. Place them in the pot with right click.
rad3q.545FD79030CAC86C.desc.8: 4. When the last ingredient has been placed, wait a few seconds. Your finished spell will pop out of the Kettle.
rad3q.5466EEF8BC1D892F.title: Tables
rad3q.546F2AA4935B5357.desc.0: A walking nest of spiders. It spawns in deep caves. Cave spiders will emerge when it is damaged.
rad3q.548F6CFC69DF205D.desc.0: Prove your worth by participating in the raid.
rad3q.548F6CFC69DF205D.desc.2: The rewards are plentiful – riches, power, and a place among these ruthless outlaws.
rad3q.548F6CFC69DF205D.desc.4: But the path is fraught with peril.
rad3q.548F6CFC69DF205D.desc.6: The villagers are not defenseless, and failure could mean a swift and brutal end.
rad3q.548F6CFC69DF205D.title: The bloody trial
rad3q.549112E2006230AB.title: Trait 2
rad3q.549BD266B80D0E30.desc.0: Without Maren's guidance, you have only one option: find the corrupted spirit yourself and destroy it before it destroys you.
rad3q.549BD266B80D0E30.desc.2: §o§8The curse feeds on inaction. Every hour you spend not moving, you can feel it tightening — a slow numbness creeping from your fingers upward. You've lost smell. You're losing colour. Soon, you won't feel the cold.§r§r
rad3q.549BD266B80D0E30.desc.4: You need to understand what you're facing. The forest holds traces of the spirit's path — §4blackened bark§r, §5withered flowers§r, §0soil that crumbles to ash§r. Follow the damage and you'll find the source.
rad3q.549BD266B80D0E30.desc.6: Maren called it a §4corrupted nature spirit§r. That means it was once something else. Something that remembers being alive.
rad3q.549BD266B80D0E30.title: Track the Corruption Alone
rad3q.54AAFEDAC41F3E7C.desc.0: Slates are the foundation of Blood Magic. They are used to craft just about everything in the mod.
rad3q.54ABCE8AF5270CF0.title: Any #apotheosis:rarity_materials
rad3q.54B8F4541F6B0151.desc.0: §eExtraction Expertise§r is your "Experience Level" specifically for the Echo Extraction ritual.
rad3q.54B8F4541F6B0151.desc.10: • §9Luck:§r The higher your §bTier§r, the more likely the Sealed Tome is to give you a "Rare" item instead of a "Common" item.
rad3q.54B8F4541F6B0151.desc.12: • §dQuantity§r: As you become a master, you learn how to pull more items out of the book.
rad3q.54B8F4541F6B0151.desc.2: It can be grouped into §bTiers§r to make the numbers easier to handle.
rad3q.54B8F4541F6B0151.desc.6: §eExpertise§r makes your life easier and your rewards better in three ways:
rad3q.54B8F4541F6B0151.desc.8: • §2Safety:§r At §eExpertise Level§r 0, the Echo Extractor is dangerous and might backfire with 30%% chance, spawning §4Temporal Remnant§r. At higher §eExpertise§r, the ritual becomes safer with down to 5%% chance.
rad3q.54B8F4541F6B0151.subtitle: The Path to Grandmastery
rad3q.54B9A2B58A5AD98E.desc.0: Slay one of the Aptrgangr guarding the Frosted Prison to obtain the key to Maledictus' chamber.

rad3q.552109E874C66707.desc.0: There are a several new mechanics and difficulty scaling to the §5Ender Dragon§r fight, making it a challenge and fun experience for any player amount.
rad3q.552109E874C66707.desc.2: - §9The fight scales with the player amount§r
rad3q.552109E874C66707.desc.3: - §2The fight scales with world and config difficulty§r
rad3q.552109E874C66707.desc.5: Don't expect a quick win with beds; the §5Dragon§r is now immune to explosion-based "cheese" tactics. You must fight it fairly while dealing with lightning bolts, respawning crystals, and aggressive Endermen. If you try to stay out of reach using flight, be prepared for the Dragon's anti-flying counter-attacks.
rad3q.552109E874C66707.subtitle: §oThe beast you once knew has evolved. The End is no longer a simple execution; it is a war zone.§r
rad3q.552F10398C8E1E8E.desc.0: The Forge is a powerful furnace used to smelt and alloy metals.

rad3q.56127AAF761DC8DA.desc.1: You can always come back here to read them again.
