rad3q.563459F7C0D8D8D3.desc.0: Advanced dungeons are exactly what they sound like. Bigger layouts, tougher monsters, and improved loot!
rad3q.563459F7C0D8D8D3.desc.2: While exploring basic dungeons you might find a Portal Keystone Block with an item in it. Take it! The item inside should be an advanced key, with a different naming convention and a different color. This is the only way to obtain advanced dungeon keys. They must be found!
rad3q.563459F7C0D8D8D3.desc.4: Your basic portal frame is not powerful enough to handle these legendary new portal keys! You must enhance your basic portal with additional blocks.
rad3q.563459F7C0D8D8D3.desc.6: First, you must hang two colorful banners, one on each spire. The banners should be white/purple with either color as the base. For reference, match the filled keyhole itself.
rad3q.563459F7C0D8D8D3.desc.8: Second you must place two Portal Crown Blocks on top of your portal frame. You're going to have to rely on finding Portal Crown Blocks as loot in basic dungeon chests.
rad3q.563459F7C0D8D8D3.subtitle: Find two portal crown blocks
rad3q.56742958BEAAE440.desc.0: The door does not open with a groan or a crash. It dissolves — the stone pulling itself apart in perfect silence, each block receding into the wall as if it was always meant to be there.
rad3q.56742958BEAAE440.desc.10: You think you understand why the Forge-Masters sealed it.
rad3q.56742958BEAAE440.desc.12: §4You are not sure those two things are compatible.
rad3q.56742958BEAAE440.desc.2: §o§8Beyond it is not a chamber. It is a §4vein of crystal§r — a seam running through the rock from floor to ceiling, descending at an angle into the earth for as far as your torch can illuminate. The crystals are the colour of deep amber, pulsing with a slow rhythmic light. Like breathing.§r§r
rad3q.56742958BEAAE440.desc.6: §o§8It is not malevolent. Not welcoming. Simply present — enormous and ancient and indifferent in the way mountains are indifferent. But it notices you. A gentle pressure. A warmth. A sense of being observed by something that has no concept of time or danger or consequence.§r§r
rad3q.56742958BEAAE440.desc.8: You think you understand now why the dwarves stayed.
rad3q.56742958BEAAE440.title: What the Dwarves Found

rad3q.56B3B70206EE7478.desc.0: The Dark Knight class is the opposite number of the Paladin, possessing the power of Darkness and often necromantic or dark-magic oriented abilities that deal large amounts of damage to enemies, although often at the cost of their own HP. They may have abilities that lower their target's stats or inflict status effects also. As the opposite of the Paladin, they may do more damage to light based enemies such as angels, fairies or other traditionally good/holy creatures even if Light Is Not Good or find such foes to be their biggest weakness.

rad3q.56D3BC7D09F900CA.desc.0: Rich Soil is an enhanced type of dirt, more fertile and durable to the elements.
rad3q.56D3BC7D09F900CA.desc.2: Rich Soil cannot be directly crafted. To make it, you must craft Organic Compost and place it into the world, letting it decompose over time.
rad3q.56D3BC7D09F900CA.desc.4: Organic Compost will decompose more easily under sunlight and moisture from nearby water, but doesn't actually hydrate like farmland. It can also be gently accelerated by placing activators next to it, in a 3x3x3 area centered on itself.
rad3q.56D3BC7D09F900CA.desc.6: Currently, the following blocks behave as activators for Organic Compost:
rad3q.56D3BC7D09F900CA.desc.7: - Brown and Red Mushrooms, and their Colonies;

rad3q.56FE6C65EF970DF6.desc.0: Connects all of the touching inventories into one.
rad3q.56FE6C65EF970DF6.desc.2: Use the Storage Terminal to access all of your items.
rad3q.577182F7C0C5B85B.desc.0: The game progress is divided into three parts: Normal Mode, Expert Mode, and Master Mode. These are not per-player, and affect the whole world.
rad3q.577182F7C0C5B85B.desc.2: - Normal Mode starts at the beginning of the game.
rad3q.577182F7C0C5B85B.desc.4: - Expert Mode starts when anyone kills the Wither. (or enters the End)
rad3q.577182F7C0C5B85B.desc.6: - Master Mode starts when the Ender Dragon is defeated by someone.
rad3q.5826E13CAB5C44F2.desc.0: As you delve deeper into the §0Old Creeping Crypt§r, the air grows colder, and the shadows seem to whisper secrets of the past.
rad3q.5826E13CAB5C44F2.desc.2: §4Your heart races§r as you navigate through the damp, stone corridors, finally stumbling upon a hidden chamber. In the flickering light of your torch, you discover a crumpled note lying on a dusty altar.
rad3q.5826E13CAB5C44F2.desc.4: Unfolding the note, you read Eli's hurried scrawl:
rad3q.5826E13CAB5C44F2.desc.6: §o§3"If you find this, know that I have embraced the truth. The artifact we seek lies within the Cultists' Crypt. Follow the path of the moonlight to the ancient oak, and there you will find the entrance hidden beneath the roots."§r§r
rad3q.5826E13CAB5C44F2.title: Find Creeping Crypt deep undergroud

rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.0: L2 adds several enchantments that can ONLY be obtained using Ars Nouveau Enchanting. Some of these are very powerful and critical for surviving the end game of this pack.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.10: §6Wind Sweep:§r Increases the sweeping hitbox of a sword.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.12: §6Void Touch:§r Has a chance to deal void damage, penetrating all defense.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.14: §6Soul Flame Thorn:§r Inflicts §bSoul Flame§r effect on attacker.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.26: §6Environment Reject:§r Immune to damage without an attacker.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.28: §bDurable Armor:§r Increases armor durability much better than Unbreaking.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.30: §bHardended:§r When the item takes damage, only one durability will be lost.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.32: §bLife Mending:§r When you heal, the damaged item will be repaired instead. Works better on armor than Apotheosis Life Mending.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.34: §bLife Sync:§r Instead of durability, health is used.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.36: §bSafeguard:§r If the item would break, it remains at one durability instead.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.38: §aEnder Reach:§r Blocks broken by this tool will be placed directly in your inventory.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.4: §6Soul Flame Blade:§r Inflicts §bSoul Flame§r effect on attack.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.40: §aSmelt:§r Blocks broken by this tool will be smelted. Also works on items inside a chest, if you break the chest.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.42: §aEnder Mask:§r Endermen will not be angered by your gaze.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.46: §aSnow Walker:§r You won't sink in powdered snow.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.48: §aSoul Bound:§r The enchanted item will remain with you on death.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.50: §aTransparent:§r When you are invisible, the item will be too.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.54: §aDampened:§r A full set of armor enchanted with this will stop your vibrations from being picked up by skulk sensors.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.56: §7Cubic Digging:§r Dig 3x3x3 blocks at once. Higher level increase radius. Sneak to bypass.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.58: §7Plane Digging:§r Dig 5x5 blocks at once (direction sensitive). Higher level increase radius. Sneak to bypass.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.60: §7Drill Digging:§r Dig 7 blocks at once (direction sensitive). Higher level increase range. Sneak to bypass.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.62: §7Vien Mining:§r Yes, that's how it's spelled. Dig connected blocks of the same type. Higher level increase max count. Sneak to bypass.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.64: §7Tree Chopper:§r Chop logs and adjacent leaves. Level 2 cleans leaves as well, and doesn't cost durability when breaking leaves. Sneak to bypass.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.66: §7Cubic Chunk Eater:§r Dig 4x4x4 chunk-aligned blocks at once. Level 2 makes it 8x8x8. Sneak to bypass.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.68: §7Planar Chunk Eater:§r Dig 16x16 chunk-aligned blocks at once. Higher level increase depth. Sneak to bypass.
rad3q.5A58777B575B6917.desc.8: §6Sharp Blade:§r Inflicts §4Bleeding§r effect on attack. Stacks the more the target is hit.

They may also receive bonuses for fighting in water terrain or on ships, or be the best class at swimming. May have some aspects of the Bandit, or the Bandit class may be folded into Pirate entirely.

rad3q.5B0D50FA170721B1.desc.4: You start digging and eventually the entrance looms before you, §0dark and foreboding§r, with the faint glow of eerie green light flickering from within.

rad3q.5C62136D3A02E4F4.desc.2: Poseidite armor is about as good as diamond armor on land. In the water, it becomes arguably the best armor in the pack, giving huge boosts to speed and defense. If you plan on wearing the full set DO NOT put Depth Strider on the boots. The Dolphin's Grace effect combined with Depth Strider will make it impossible to control your player in the water.

rad3q.5C6AC4DE0A725B7E.desc.0: Tracking the Throne leads you to a second, larger ruin — a half-collapsed palace, its entrance flanked by two enormous amber-eyed statues.
rad3q.5C6AC4DE0A725B7E.desc.4: §o§8The statues' eyes follow you as you approach. Not a trick of the light. They are watching. Something inside this place is already aware of your presence.§r§r
rad3q.5C6AC4DE0A725B7E.desc.6: The air inside the palace is thick and dry, tasting of ozone and old stone. Every footstep echoes like a drumbeat.
rad3q.5C6AC4DE0A725B7E.desc.8: The Throne room lies ahead — and the tablet in your pack is burning now.
rad3q.5C6AC4DE0A725B7E.title: The Amber Palace

rad3q.5E598ADB0425DE0A.desc.0: The mining progression of the mod is depth based, and vanilla tools aren’t very good in Icaria. While you can take your diamond pickaxe into the dimension to get started, it won’t help you get through the stronger stone types. From the top down, you will encounter these materials:
rad3q.5E598ADB0425DE0A.desc.1: Yellowstone, Silkstone, Sunstone, Voidshale, and Baetyl.
rad3q.5E598ADB0425DE0A.desc.3: Each stone type has its own subset of ores that can be found within. Yellowstone requires a Chert Pickaxe to mine, Silkstone requires a Chalkos Pickaxe, Sunstone requires an Orichalcum Pickaxe, Voidshale requires a Vanadiumsteel Pickaxe, and Baetyl requires a Sideros Pickaxe.
rad3q.5E598ADB0425DE0A.desc.5: However, you can ignore all this in one of three ways:
rad3q.5E598ADB0425DE0A.desc.6: a. The break spell from Ars Nouveau
rad3q.5E598ADB0425DE0A.desc.8: c. Loot villages for better materials
rad3q.5E598ADB0425DE0A.desc.9: If you choose the first two, I recommend also having a magnet so you don't lose items to the void.
rad3q.5E598ADB0425DE0A.title: Enter Icaria

rad3q.5E8977CB9DC9D8F7.desc.4: Oh? You wanted to use this to set your spawn? Why bother? Bonfires work in any dimension.

rad3q.5F0EF1F7393E8C68.desc.0: The notice from the tavern board mentioned it: §6The Wandering Hold.§r
rad3q.5F0EF1F7393E8C68.desc.2: §o§8Now you know what it is. Not a place — or not exactly. A system Desram built before he vanished, to keep the cycle moving. A set of standing arrangements with brokers, traders, and old contacts who owe him more than they'd like to admit.§r§r
rad3q.5F0EF1F7393E8C68.desc.4: Bring them an §6iron-banded crate§r — proof of a dungeon run, proof you've kept working — and they'll give you a new blade. Or resources. Or other things, depending on what you bring and who's buying.
rad3q.5F0EF1F7393E8C68.desc.6: §o§8The brokers ask no questions. They check the compass rose stamp on the crate, check it again, and deal. That's all Desram ever asked of anyone: do the work, deal straight, move on.§r§r

rad3q.5F578BB3FEEB067B.desc.0: The defense meter is the little shield under your crosshair that appears whenever you block or parry. Whenever you parry a blow or block one with a shield, your defense meter is reduced. If it hits zero, you are briefly stunned, and any shield you were using is disabled briefly. It recharges fairly quickly, but higher damage blows will reduce the meter more, so be careful when up against high damage enemies such as vindicators or players with a hammer.

rad3q.75434610CC4789B4.desc.0: Pet Masters specialize in controlling a powerful "pet" to fight by their side. The pet can be anything from a tamed animal to a summoned elemental to a constructed Golem, but usually it serves as a front-line melee combatant while the master hangs back to support it with healing, buffing and long-range attacks. In extreme cases the master does not take part in combat at all. If the pet is an animal then this class is often folded into Ranger or Nature Magician, and comes with the ability to control animals in general. If folded into Summoner then the character might have access to multiple pets, but only be able to use one at a time.

rad3q.76253B8D309F08B1.desc.0: This magical flower can only be found in certain structures. It can only survive on crystal blocks, like crystallized honey or amethyst. It can be picked up and moved without needing Silk Touch, and saves its Tier and experience when moved.
rad3q.76253B8D309F08B1.desc.2: When fed items or levels, the flower grows, up to 7 blocks, or tiers, high. ANY item can be used. Honey. Planks. Dirt. Rotten flesh. Some items are worth more than others, using a point system I don't understand, but you can easily fuel this thing with vast quantities of trash. As the flower gets taller, you need more items to make it grow another tier.
rad3q.76253B8D309F08B1.desc.4: The top slot of the flower's UI is for books or enchanted books. Put one in, and you can spend tiers to enchant books with almost any enchantment you want! At the highest tier, 7, you can even buy treasure enchantments! The highest level of book you can buy may not be the highest level an enchantment can be at. If the highest level §ois§r available, there will be a little star next to the enchantment's level.
rad3q.76253B8D309F08B1.desc.6: Basically, this thing is rare but OP as hell. Turn your vast hoard of random garbage into high level enchantments!

An old one, between Desram and a line of Pillager captains who used the same contraband routes back when the King was still operational. They owed him passage and never paid. rad3q.7F23DAD698D6D126.desc.0: Rogues are a diverse class that contains everything from dexterous thieves, to treasure-hunters, to assassins. Masters of stealth and infiltration, Rogues prefer to attack when their opponent is least aware. They are quick but fragile, unable to take heavy damage, and instead rely on their speed to dodge attacks and slip in and out of the shadows to catch their opponent off guard; setting traps and inflicting status effects on foes to give them the edge. Outside of battle Rogues usually have a wide range of helpful utility abilities such as lockpicking to allow them to open locked doors and treasure chests without needing to find/buy keys or the ability to detect and disarm traps. Some can even steal items directly from enemies allowing the player to obtain items that otherwise might be unobtainable. Sometimes Rogues are lumped in with the Ranger class, but more commonly they are differentiated by specializing in melee - particularly with light blades and daggers or ranged attacks using throwing weapons such as knives and shuriken.
